expertise_en: Plant pathology, horticulture and forestry; epidemiology and diversity of Fusarium oxysporum (Panama disease TR4); sustainable banana cultivation
expertise_zh: 植物病理、園藝與林業；尖孢鐮刀菌（巴拿馬病 TR4）流行病學與多樣性；香蕉永續栽培
summary_en: After reviewing his published work on the epidemiology, infection biology and diversity of F. oxysporum, the team held an online interview with Dr. Drenth to test the viability of its solution. He pointed out that root turnover could let banana roots grow beyond the protective bacterial barrier, leaving new roots exposed to fungal spores in the soil.
summary_zh: 團隊研讀 Drenth 教授關於尖孢鐮刀菌流行病學、感染生物學與多樣性的論文後，與他進行線上訪談，檢驗解決方案的可行性。他指出「根系更新」（root turnover）可能使香蕉根長出保護性菌層之外，讓新根暴露於土壤中的真菌孢子。
impact_en: The Wetlab team shifted implementation from field application to inoculation at the nursery/plantlet stage with continued application during vegetative growth; his suggestions (and his published TR4 spread parameters) also shaped Drylab's economic model and the hardware application regimen.
impact_zh: 濕實驗組因此將應用方式從田間施用改為在育苗／組培苗階段接種，並於營養生長期持續施用；他的建議（以及其發表的 TR4 擴散參數）也影響了乾實驗組的經濟模型與硬體施用排程。

photos.caption_zh: 與 Drenth 教授線上會議

org_zh: 財團法人台灣香蕉研究所
expertise_en: Banana cultivation and tissue-culture plantlet production; Fusarium wilt (TR4) and resistant cultivars (GCTCV Tai-Chiao No. 5 and No. 7)
expertise_zh: 香蕉栽培與組織培養種苗生產；香蕉黃葉病（TR4）與抗病品種（台蕉五號、七號）
summary_en: The team first held an online Google Meet with Mr. Chen, who recommended applying the solution in TBRI's controlled plantlet facilities and at earlier stages of plant life. On 10 August 2022 the team visited TBRI: Mr. Chen presented on banana planting, plantation management and Panama disease, explained the trade-offs of the resistant Tai-Chiao No. 5 and No. 7 cultivars, and toured them through the tissue-culture lab, quarantine screen house, infected fields, the seedling order center and a variety farm. The visit also gave the team access to TBRI's journal archive, which is not available online.
summary_zh: 團隊先與陳先生進行 Google Meet 線上訪談，他建議將方案應用於香蕉研究所的受控種苗設施，並在植株生命早期施用。2022 年 8 月 10 日團隊實地參訪香蕉研究所：陳先生簡報香蕉種植、蕉園管理與巴拿馬病，說明抗病品種台蕉五號與七號的取捨，並帶領團隊參觀組織培養實驗室、檢疫網室、染病田區、種苗訂購中心與品種園。此行也讓團隊得以查閱網路上無法取得的所內期刊檔案。
impact_en: The team redirected its solution toward potted plantlets rather than fully grown plants, and built its B2B marketing and implementation plan around selling the inoculant to plantlet producers such as TBRI, whose technicians would inoculate plantlets before distribution to farmers.
impact_zh: 團隊將方案改為針對盆栽種苗而非成株，並以 B2B 模式規劃行銷與落地：由香蕉研究所等種苗生產單位的技術人員在配送給農民前先為種苗接種。

photos.caption_zh: 與香蕉研究所線上會議

unit_zh: 農藝學系 生物統計組
expertise_en: Biometry; GMO regulation (former committee member of the Taiwan Council of Agriculture)
expertise_zh: 生物統計；基因改造生物法規（曾任行政院農業委員會委員）
summary_en: The team interviewed Prof. Liu to refine its implementation and marketing plan and learn the regulations for producing a GMO-based product. Drawing on her time on the Council of Agriculture, she explained that GMO production is prohibited in Taiwan so mass production would have to be abroad, that the COA requires a strict set of tests before GMOs can be commercialized, and discussed pricing given the high cost and long field-testing timeline of GMO products.
summary_zh: 團隊訪談劉力瑜教授，以精進落地與行銷計畫並了解基改產品生產的相關法規。她以曾任職農委會的經驗說明：臺灣禁止在境內生產基改生物，量產須在國外進行；農委會對基改生物商品化前有嚴格的試驗要求；她也討論了基改產品高昂開發成本與漫長田間試驗對定價的影響。
impact_en: The team gained a clearer understanding of Taiwan's strict GMO regulations and, on her recommendation, incorporated specific Taiwanese pesticide/biopesticide regulations into its entrepreneurship page.
impact_zh: 團隊更清楚了解臺灣對基改生物的嚴格規範，並依她的建議將臺灣農藥／生物農藥相關法規納入創業頁面。

unit_en: Lab 106, Synthetic Biology and Biofabrication Laboratory (Department of Biochemical Science and Technology)
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 合成生物與生物製造實驗室（Lab 106）
expertise_en: Molecular cloning; protein expression; lab safety supervision
expertise_zh: 分子選殖；蛋白質表現；實驗室安全督導
summary_en: The team's wet-lab work was carried out in Lab 106, a BSL-1 lab, under constant supervision by NTU graduate students and trained lab technicians. The Attributions page credits Yung-Che Tsai, Tzy-Shyuan Hsu, Chi-Ting Sung and Ming-Yan Shen for lab support, and the notebook thanks a lab member (Bryan) for help with transformations.
summary_zh: 團隊的濕實驗在生物安全第一等級實驗室 Lab 106 進行，全程由臺大研究生與受訓技術人員督導。致謝頁列出 Yung-Che Tsai、Tzy-Shyuan Hsu、Chi-Ting Sung、Ming-Yan Shen 提供實驗支援，實驗記錄亦感謝 Bryan 協助轉形。
impact_en: Tips from Lab 106 personnel helped the team devise a thermolysis protein-extraction protocol when sonication/chemical lysis equipment was unavailable; the protocol was later shared as a contribution for future iGEM teams.
impact_zh: 在缺乏超音波與化學裂解設備的情況下，Lab 106 成員的建議協助團隊發展出熱裂解蛋白萃取流程，後來作為貢獻分享給未來的 iGEM 隊伍。

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
summary_en: The NTU Department of Biochemical Science and Technology logo is displayed in the Sponsors section of the team's Attributions page; the team's lab work took place in the department's Lab 106.
summary_zh: 臺大生化科技學系的系徽列於團隊致謝頁的贊助單位區；團隊的實驗亦在該系 Lab 106 進行。

expertise_en: DNA synthesis; oligonucleotides and gene fragments
expertise_zh: DNA 合成；寡核苷酸與基因片段
summary_en: IDT's logo appears in the Sponsors section of the team's Attributions page. The wiki gives no further detail on what was provided.
summary_zh: IDT 的標誌列於團隊致謝頁的贊助單位區，維基未進一步說明贊助內容。

org_zh: 泰國 Ruamrudee 國際學校
expertise_en: Bacterial wilt in crops; bee-venom-derived antimicrobial enzymes
expertise_zh: 作物青枯病；蜂毒來源的抗菌酵素
summary_en: Because both teams worked on wilt diseases in agriculture, GEMS_Taiwan and Thailand_RIS held multiple meetings exchanging ideas on proteins that disrupt pathogen cell walls/membranes (Thailand_RIS used bee-venom enzymes against bacterial wilt). Thailand_RIS distributed GEMS_Taiwan's public survey in its community, and the two teams co-founded the infographic translation partnership (Thai translations by Thailand_RIS) after recognising the language barrier in their communities. In later meetings they discussed implementation, wet-lab progress and gave feedback on the wiki design.
summary_zh: 兩隊都處理農業上的萎凋病，因此多次開會交流破壞病原菌細胞壁／膜的蛋白質策略（Thailand_RIS 使用蜂毒酵素對付青枯病）。Thailand_RIS 協助在其社群發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷，兩隊也因察覺各自社群的語言隔閡而共同發起資訊圖表翻譯合作計畫（由 Thailand_RIS 負責泰文翻譯）。後續會議中雙方討論落地方式與濕實驗進度，並互相回饋維基設計。
impact_en: Thailand_RIS suggested applying the chitinase protein itself to the soil rather than the living GMO, which would greatly reduce regulatory burden and time to market; this became an alternative implementation route on the hardware and safety pages. The survey exchange diversified respondents and sparked the translation partnership.
impact_zh: Thailand_RIS 建議直接將幾丁質酶蛋白施用於土壤而非施用活的基改菌，可大幅降低法規負擔與上市時間，成為硬體與安全頁中的替代落地方案。問卷交流使受訪者更多元，也催生了翻譯合作計畫。

photos.caption_en: Core translation team of the infographic translation project
photos.caption_zh: 資訊圖表翻譯計畫核心翻譯團隊
Thailand_RIS 資訊圖表中文翻譯版

org_en: iGEM high school team, South Korea
org_zh: 韓國高中 iGEM 隊伍
expertise_en: DNA data storage to address climate change
expertise_zh: 以 DNA 資料儲存因應氣候變遷
summary_en: Korea_HS was the first team GEMS_Taiwan reached out to. In a first meeting the teams exchanged project ideas and Korea_HS distributed GEMS_Taiwan's public survey in Korea; in a second meeting they planned collaborations. GEMS_Taiwan submitted a short video on Fusarium wilt to Korea_HS's Instagram reels project, and Korea_HS joined the core infographic translation team, translating infographics into Korean.
summary_zh: Korea_HS 是 GEMS_Taiwan 第一個聯繫的隊伍。第一次會議中雙方交流專案構想，Korea_HS 並協助在韓國發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷；第二次會議則規劃合作項目。GEMS_Taiwan 為 Korea_HS 的 Instagram Reels 計畫提交介紹香蕉黃葉病的短片，Korea_HS 則加入資訊圖表核心翻譯團隊，負責韓文翻譯。
impact_en: Expanded both teams' audiences: GEMS_Taiwan's survey and infographics reached Korean communities, and the first meeting gave the team practice presenting its project for later collaboration meetings.
impact_zh: 擴大雙方受眾：GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷與資訊圖表觸及韓國社群，第一次會議也讓團隊練習簡報，為後續合作會議做準備。

photos.caption_zh: GEMS_Taiwan 與 Korea_HS Reels 合作

expertise_zh: iGEM 資訊圖表挪威文翻譯
summary_en: Recruited by direct message, UiOslo_Norway joined GEMS_Taiwan, Thailand_RIS and Korea_HS as a core member of the infographic translation partnership, translating other teams' infographics into Norwegian and sharing its own infographic. The core teams coordinated through a group chat and online meetings over several months.
summary_zh: UiOslo_Norway 經私訊邀請，與 GEMS_Taiwan、Thailand_RIS、Korea_HS 共同組成資訊圖表翻譯計畫核心團隊，負責將各隊資訊圖表譯為挪威文，並提供自己的資訊圖表。核心團隊數月間透過群組與線上會議協調。
impact_en: Allowed the infographic exhibition to reach Norwegian-speaking communities.
impact_zh: 讓資訊圖表展覽得以觸及挪威語社群。

photos.caption_zh: UiOslo_Norway 資訊圖表中文翻譯版

org_zh: 紐約州立大學石溪分校
expertise_en: Protein S deficiency; public science communication (journal archive)
expertise_zh: 蛋白質 S 缺乏症；科學傳播（期刊彙編）
summary_en: Stony_Brook invited GEMS_Taiwan to its public journal archive project. The Wetlab and HP teams wrote a three-page article explaining banana domestication and disease vulnerability, the people who depend on the banana market, and the team's biochemical solution. Stony_Brook also helped spread GEMS_Taiwan's public survey to its community.
summary_zh: Stony_Brook 邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其公眾期刊彙編計畫，團隊濕實驗組與人文實踐組撰寫三頁文章，說明香蕉馴化導致的病害脆弱性、依賴香蕉市場的族群，以及團隊的生化解決方案。Stony_Brook 也協助在其社群發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷。
impact_en: Provided another outreach pathway for raising awareness of Fusarium wilt among the public and future iGEM teams.
impact_zh: 為向大眾與未來 iGEM 隊伍推廣香蕉黃葉病議題提供另一條管道。

photos.caption_en: GEMS_Taiwan article in Stony Brook's journal
photos.caption_zh: GEMS_Taiwan 刊登於 Stony Brook 期刊的文章

expertise_en: Chronic wound treatment; Mandarin synthetic-biology video outreach
expertise_zh: 慢性傷口治療；中文合成生物學影片推廣
summary_en: NCHU_Taichung invited GEMS_Taiwan to its short-video project, a Mandarin YouTube channel introducing Taiwanese iGEM teams to local communities. GEMS_Taiwan submitted a short educational video about its project, which NCHU_Taichung posted on YouTube.
summary_zh: NCHU_Taichung 邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其短片計畫，透過中文 YouTube 頻道向在地社群介紹臺灣各 iGEM 隊伍。GEMS_Taiwan 提交介紹專案的教育短片，由 NCHU_Taichung 發布於 YouTube。
impact_en: The video gained several dozen views, adding to the team's awareness-raising efforts in Mandarin.
impact_zh: 影片獲得數十次觀看，強化團隊以中文推廣議題的成果。

org_en: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
summary_en: NYCU_Formosa hosted an in-person meet-up at its university where the two teams' drylab members discussed modeling techniques and NYCU's wet lab showed GEMS_Taiwan's wet lab around its lab and gave experimental suggestions. NYCU then invited GEMS_Taiwan to its BioArt collaboration, co-hosted with KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei at Kang Chiao International School on 1 September 2022 (BioArt, gel electrophoresis and project introductions for about 20 students). NYCU_Formosa also submitted an infographic for translation.
summary_zh: NYCU_Formosa 在其校園舉辦實體交流會，兩隊乾實驗成員討論建模技術，NYCU 濕實驗組帶 GEMS_Taiwan 濕實驗組參觀實驗室並提供實驗建議。NYCU 也邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其生物藝術合作，於 2022 年 9 月 1 日與 KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 在康橋國際學校共同舉辦工作坊（生物藝術、膠體電泳與專案介紹，約 20 名學生參加）。NYCU_Formosa 亦提交資訊圖表供翻譯。
impact_en: Gave the team modeling and experimentation suggestions and a venue to present its project and synthetic biology to high-school students.
impact_zh: 為團隊提供建模與實驗建議，並提供向高中生介紹專案與合成生物學的機會。

org_zh: 康橋國際學校（秀岡校區）
summary_en: GEMS_Taiwan coordinated with KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei to host the BioArt event in KCIS's labs together with NYCU_Formosa, educating biology-inclined KCIS students. KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei also sent its infographic to the translation project and distributed GEMS_Taiwan's team introduction in its school newspaper.
summary_zh: GEMS_Taiwan 與 KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 協調，並與 NYCU_Formosa 在康橋實驗室共同舉辦生物藝術活動，教育對生物有興趣的康橋學生。KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 也將資訊圖表交付翻譯計畫，並在校刊刊登 GEMS_Taiwan 的團隊介紹。
impact_en: Opened a dialogue with biology-inclined students and spread awareness of synthetic biology across the school.
impact_zh: 建立與對生物有興趣學生的對話，並在全校推廣合成生物學。

photos.caption_zh: 在康橋的教育簡報（生物藝術工作坊）

summary_en: The teams connected at the Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup and joined each other's projects. GEMS_Taiwan contributed a braised tofu fish recipe (with fish and tomato for heart health) to CCU_Taiwan's CVD-prevention cookbook, and CCU_Taiwan submitted its infographic to the translation project, among the first to be translated.
summary_zh: 兩隊在臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會上結識並參與彼此的計畫。GEMS_Taiwan 為 CCU_Taiwan 的心血管疾病預防食譜提供豆腐燒魚食譜（含有益心臟的魚與番茄），CCU_Taiwan 則提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，是最早完成翻譯的隊伍之一。

photos.caption_zh: CCU_Taiwan 資訊圖表中文翻譯版

unit_en: Host of the 2022 Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup
unit_zh: 2022 臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會主辦
expertise_zh: 主辦臺灣 iGEM 隊伍交流會
summary_en: On 23 August 2022 the team attended the Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup held at NCKU and organized by Taiwan's iGEM ambassador. Each team presented its project and progress and received peer-review-style questions and suggestions, followed by a Jamboree-style networking session hosted by team NCKU.
summary_zh: 2022 年 8 月 23 日，團隊參加由臺灣 iGEM 大使籌辦、在成功大學舉行的臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會。各隊報告專案與進度並接受同儕審查式的提問與建議，之後由 NCKU 隊伍主持類似 Jamboree 的交流活動。
impact_en: Sharpened the team's presentation and Q&A skills, created new collaboration opportunities (e.g., CCU_Taiwan) and enriched the infographic collection for the translation project.
impact_zh: 提升團隊簡報與答詢能力，創造新的合作機會（如 CCU_Taiwan），並充實翻譯計畫的資訊圖表收藏。

photos.caption_zh: 臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會

org_zh: 臺中市私立明道高級中學
summary_en: Mingdao submitted its infographic to the infographic translation project; the core team translated it into Mandarin, Norwegian, Thai and Korean for the online exhibition and Instagram.
summary_zh: Mingdao 提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，核心團隊將其譯為中文、挪威文、泰文與韓文，展示於線上展覽與 Instagram。

photos.caption_zh: Mingdao 資訊圖表（中文翻譯）

org_zh: 杜塞道夫海因里希·海涅大學
summary_en: Team Düsseldorf submitted its infographic to the infographic translation project; the core team translated it into Mandarin, Norwegian, Thai and Korean for the online exhibition and Instagram.
summary_zh: Düsseldorf 隊伍提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，核心團隊將其譯為中文、挪威文、泰文與韓文，展示於線上展覽與 Instagram。

photos.caption_zh: Düsseldorf 資訊圖表（中文翻譯）

unit_zh: 兩校區 6 至 11 年級學生
summary_en: The team gave in-person presentations to students at two Kang Chiao International School campuses: an interactive Chinese-language session for 7th graders and an advanced English session for 10th graders. On 1 September 2022 it co-organized, with NYCU_Formosa and KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei, an educational panel for about 20 biology-interested students covering BioArt, gel electrophoresis, dry-lab models and the project, ending with a Kahoot game. An animated educational video was also emailed via homeroom teachers to more than 1,500 6th and 8th graders.
summary_zh: 團隊在康橋國際學校兩個校區進行實體簡報：以中文互動方式向七年級介紹，並以英文進階版向十年級簡報。2022 年 9 月 1 日與 NYCU_Formosa、KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 共同為約 20 名對生物有興趣的學生舉辦教育活動，內容包括生物藝術、膠體電泳、乾實驗模型與專案介紹，最後以 Kahoot 遊戲收尾。團隊也透過導師將動畫教育影片寄給超過 1,500 名六、八年級學生。
impact_en: Raised awareness of the banana crisis and synthetic biology among students and encouraged them to join iGEM the following year.
impact_zh: 提升學生對香蕉危機與合成生物學的認識，並鼓勵他們參加隔年的 iGEM。

photos.caption_zh: 康橋生物藝術工作坊簡報

org_zh: 臺北市私立復興實驗高級中學
summary_en: The team presented the advanced English version of its educational slides on the banana crisis and its solution to 11th graders at Taipei Fuhsing Private School.
summary_zh: 團隊以英文進階版教材向復興實驗高中 11 年級學生介紹香蕉危機與團隊的解決方案。
impact_en: Extended the team's education efforts to a wider range of ages beyond its own school network.
impact_zh: 將團隊教育推廣擴及更多年齡層與其他學校。

org_en: Pedestrians at Daan Forest Park and Taipei 101
org_zh: 大安森林公園與台北 101 周邊民眾
expertise_en: Middle-aged and older members of the public; banana consumers
expertise_zh: 中高齡民眾；香蕉消費者
summary_en: To reach middle-aged and older people less comfortable with online surveys, the whole HP team conducted an on-street survey at Da-an Park and Taipei 101, asking passers-by to complete the public survey while explaining the banana crisis. Together with online distribution, the survey collected 1,595 responses.
summary_zh: 為觸及較不熟悉線上問卷的中高齡族群，人文實踐組全員到大安森林公園與台北 101 進行街頭問卷，邀請路人填答並同時說明香蕉危機。連同線上發放，問卷共回收 1,595 份。
impact_en: Survey results (84.1% unaware of Fusarium wilt; 67.1% distrusting GM plants) led the team to put more background in its education materials and to protect the plant externally with engineered soil probiotics rather than genetically modifying the banana itself.
impact_zh: 問卷結果（84.1% 不知道香蕉黃葉病、67.1% 不信任基改植物）促使團隊在教材中加入更多背景說明，並選擇以工程化土壤益生菌從植株外部保護，而非直接改造香蕉。
